nodes.label: antislop Core Rule Set
nodes.rationale: A filter, not a style guide: rejects technique-without-purpose and requires liveliness so AI UI feels crafted rather than generic.

nodes.label: Hard Gate Rule Group (R-02..R-38)
nodes.rationale: Absolute rules protecting honesty, function, and accessibility; breaking any is a FAIL regardless of purpose.

nodes.label: Purpose-Gate Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Visual techniques (gradients, glow, icons, badges) are allowed only when a written purpose ties them to hierarchy or identity; the technique is not the problem, the purpose is.

nodes.label: Three Dials (ENERGY/RHYTHM/MOTION)
nodes.rationale: Three discrete levels make liveliness enforceable and checkable, unlike continuous 1-10 scales a reviewer cannot judge reliably.

nodes.label: Liveliness Toolkit
nodes.rationale: Removing slop leaves a void; positive levers (focal point, hierarchical contrast, whitespace, deliberate accent, identity motif) must deliberately add energy.

nodes.label: Craftsmanship Standard (C-1..C-5)
nodes.rationale: Five preference-agnostic criteria (intentionality, functional completeness, content-driven composition, resilience, evidence over claims) that make design done, not merely not-slop.

nodes.label: Delivery Gate
nodes.rationale: Mandatory PASS/FAIL report before delivery; a deliverable without a clean gate is unfinished and cannot be delegated to another workflow's summary.

nodes.label: R-31 Every Decision Must Have a Reason
nodes.rationale: Keystone rule: writing a one-line reason for every major visual decision forces intent, which is exactly what the Purpose-Gate checks.

nodes.label: R-37 Design Direction Required
nodes.rationale: Building UI without DESIGN.md or owner direction silently falls into sterile defaults; output must be labeled a draft with honest ENERGY 1/RHYTHM 1/MOTION 1 dials.

nodes.label: R-34 Every Theme You Ship Must Work
nodes.rationale: A shipped theme toggle must be fully functional in both modes; a dark mode that breaks light mode is a defect.

nodes.label: R-13 Glow Dose Cap
nodes.rationale: Glow is a focus accent on at most 1-2 elements; simultaneous glow on cards, buttons, badges, icons, backgrounds, and borders is forbidden.
